about: Data for lab/audit-wall.html. Every number is taken on the pinned tree, not the live set.

definitions.ink: Ink: the inked area at the master's own size, in pixels (one unit = one pixel). Exact geometry, supersampled at rate 32, through card 1.5's bypass (docs/audit/findings-mass.md §1, §1.1).
definitions.share: Ink mass: ink ÷ canvas² — how dark the icon is in a row. Not ink ÷ its own box, which ranks a minus the densest icon in the set (card 1.5 M-7). Render size does not change it, so "24 at 16 px" sorts by the 24 master's share.
definitions.squint: Squint peak: the darkest patch after a σ 1.5 px blur of the drawing at the size shown (0 = no ink, 1 = solid). Card 1.5's construct at the 16 master (§2.4); at 20, 24 and 24-at-16 it is the same recipe at that size, measured by this tool.
definitions.strokes: Stroke count: subpaths — every M in the path data starts one — over all the file's paths. Card 1.4's "detail count" (docs/audit/findings-scaling.md:256). A cut-out in a filled drawing counts as one.
definitions.paths: Paths: the number of <path> elements in the file.
definitions.family: Family: card 1.10's partition (tools/audit/families.mjs): size and number taken off, the four directions of arrow and chevron folded, plus/minus/x-circle kept apart from their marks — 128 stems.
definitions.kind: Kind: from the outline file's note, as card 1.5 reads it — keyline: mark → mark; box: → box; anchor: → anchor; else silhouette.
definitions.band: Band: card 1.5's, ink as a multiple of its row's median (that master and style): Hairline < 0.5 · Light < 0.75 · Level < 1.25 · Full < 1.5 · Dense ≥ 1.5.
